newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria watchdog sees record insolvencies in 96.
newsitem.headline: Austria watchdog sees record insolvencies in 96.

text.p: Austria's credit protection agency said on Thursday it expected the number of insolvencies in Austria to rise to a new post-World War Two record this year.
It said insolvencies were expected to rise to as high as 5,400 this year, up eight percent on 1995.

Last year's 4,994 insolvencies were already a post-war record, the agency said in a statement. "The highest number of insolvencies so far was recorded in 1932 with 5,580," it added. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
